content: SGLT2 inhibitors, including empagliflozin, dapagliflozin, and canagliflozin, have been shown to significantly lower the risk of hospitalizations due to heart failure and improve cardiovascular outcomes in individuals with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease. Clinical trials, such as EMPEROR-Preserved and DELIVER, have demonstrated that these medications reduce the incidence of heart failure events and mortality rates, regardless of whether the patient has diabetes. This indicates that SGLT2 inhibitors provide substantial benefits for patients with heart failure across a broad spectrum of conditions.
